utterance:
Here's the plan. You have a simple bladder infection. I've prescribed trimethoprim 300 mg — one tablet at night for 3 days. Your symptoms should start improving within a day or two. It won't affect your pill. Drink plenty of water, and you can take paracetamol or ibuprofen for the discomfort. Urinating after sex can help reduce future infections. The chlamydia result takes a couple of days — we'll contact you if anything's positive.
Please come back, or go to the emergency department if it's after hours, if you get a fever, shivers, pain in your back or side, vomiting, or feel really unwell — those can mean the infection has reached your kidneys. Also come back if you're not getting better after 2–3 days of antibiotics, if symptoms return soon after, if you see blood in your urine, or if you get unusual discharge or think you could be pregnant.
